info.description: HTTP API for the BengoBox ordering service - online delivery/shipping orders only.
info.title: Ordering Service API

get.description: Lists all delivery addresses for the current user

post.description: Creates a new delivery address for the current user

get.description: Retrieves the current user's default delivery address
Retrieves a delivery address by its ID

put.description: Sets the specified address as the user's default delivery address

get.description: Lists all orders with optional filters
Returns high-level metrics (revenue, orders, trends)
Retrieves any order by its ID

delete.description: Permanently deletes an order. Only cancelled/refunded/completed orders can be deleted.

post.description: Cancels an order with a reason

put.description: Assigns a fleet member (rider) to a delivery order, auto-creating the logistics task if needed. Only valid for delivery-fulfilment orders; the order is then moved to out_for_delivery.
put.summary: Assign a rider to a delivery order

put.description: Updates the status of an order (admin only)
